pages.text: Health 55, armor 2, attack 7, movement speed 0.37.$(br)Fire immune. Spawns wearing the Serpon Powerhouse set and a weapon, either a Serpon Spear or a Serpon Glaive.$(br)$(l)Melee$(): longer attack reach; on hit, deals a half-damage sweep to the other enemies in a small area.
$(l)Charge$(): has a chance to charge, 6s cooldown.
